name: Utokolaki
body:
Utokolakis are small, vicious humanoids distantly related to goblins. They are nocturnal hunters who dwell under the canopy of dense rain forests and ravenously eat everything—and everyone—that crosses their path.

Physical

Utokolakis stand just over three feet tall on average, although they often crouch even lower to the ground to hide their presence as they wait to ambush their prey. When they do stand erect, their legs and arms look comically long compared to their torsos, and their head is wide and flat.

An utokolaki’s skin is lumpy and green, blending with ease into the jungle shadows.

Many have tufts of coarse black or brown hair, but others are completely bald. They have lupine ears, large yellow catlike eyes, and wide mouths full of sharp, stubby teeth.

Social

Utokolakis roam through the jungle, using their climbing skills to move both under and through the trees. They are famously hungry, and although they are omnivorous, they prefer meat. If given a choice, they prefer the flesh of a conquered humanoid foe over all other meals.

Utokolakis prefer to ambush their prey, although their impatience often gets the better of them. They are capable hunters, especially skilled with javelins, nets, and small blades. Many train small animals to help, and they are known to be especially fond of vermin companions such as giant wasps and spiders.

The few permanent settlements that utokolakis form are all well above the jungle floor, built on platforms high in the canopy where they can be more easily defended.

Alignment And Religion

Most utokolakis are selfish, cruel, and completely lacking in empathy. Their number one priority is feeding their unending appetite. They are almost all Evil, and most are also Chaotic.

An utokolaki approaches religion as a matter of convenience. Most serve dark, mysterious powers that even they do not fully understand, with spiritual leaders usually being oracles, witches, or even shamans, but almost never clerics.

Core Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are exceptionally agile but weak of body and will. Your ability score modifiers are +4 Dex, –2 Str, –2 Wis [greater paragon]. (2)
Size As a Small creature, you have a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a +1 size bonus to your Armor Class, a –1 size penalty to your CMB, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks. You must use smaller weapons than Medium creatures. As a Small creature, you occupy a space of 5 feet by 5 feet. Your reach is 5 feet. (0)
Type You are a Humanoid with the goblin subtype. (0)
Speed Your base speed is 30 feet. (0)
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Utokolaki. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Draconic, Elven, Goblin, Grippli, Nagaji, and Sylvan. (0)
Other Traits
Camouflage You gain a +4 species bonus on Stealth checks while within forest or jungle terrain. (1)
Climb You have a climb speed of 20 feet, and gain the +8 species bonus on Climb checks that a climb speed normally grants. (2)
Keen Senses You receive a +2 species bonus on Perception checks. (2)
Light Sensitivity You are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell. (–1)
Low-light Vision You can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. You retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions. (1)
Weapon Familiarity You are proficient with the atlatl, javelin, net, and short sword. (2)
Total: 9 RP (standard)
Variants
River Utokolaki

Some utokolakis have adapted to life in wetlands and river basins.

Hold Breath You can hold your breath for a number of rounds equal to four times your Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating. This trait replaces camouflage.

Swim You have a swim speed of 20 feet, and gain the +8 species bonus on Swim checks that a swim speed normally grants. This trait replaces climb.

Savage Utokolaki

Some utokolakis eschew weapons, preferring to attack with tooth and nail.

Ability Scores Instead of the usual utokolaki ability score modifiers, you gain a flat +2 bonus to Dex. This trait alters ability score modifiers.
Frenzy Once per day, whenever you take damage, you can fly into a frenzy for 1 minute, gaining a +2 species bonus to Constitution and Strength, but a –2 penalty to AC. This trait replaces keen senses.
Natural Weaponry You gain a bite attack and two claw attacks. These are primary natural attacks that deal 1d3 damage each. This trait replaces weapon familiarity.
Alternate Traits
Agile You receive a +2 species bonus on Acrobatics checks. This trait replaces keen senses.
Change Shape (Su) You can transform into a small shrub, tree, or tree log, with results similar to tree shape. In this form, you remain size Small, and appear as a healthy, intact specimen of the chosen vegetation. You can assume plant form or revert to your true form as a swift action. This trait replaces weapon familiarity.
Diurnal You have trained yourself to hunt during the day, and are no longer harmed by bright light. This trait replaces light sensitivity and low-light vision.
Kneecapper You specialize in hiding in the underbrush and ambushing foes from below. You gain a +4 species bonus on combat maneuver checks to trip an opponent. This trait replaces weapon familiarity.
Mistsight You can see through non-magical fog, mist, murky water, and smoke as if they were perfectly clear, ignoring any cover or concealment from these obstructions, up to the normal range of your vision. This trait replaces low-light vision.
Natural Armor You have tough skin resembling tree bark, providing you with a +1 natural armor bonus to AC. This trait replaces keen senses.
Poison Use You are skilled with poison and never risk accidentally poisoning yourself when applying it to weapons. This trait replaces camouflage.
Favored Class Bonuses
Barbarian Add +1 to your base speed. In combat this option has no effect unless you have selected it five times (or another increment of five). This bonus stacks with your fast movement feature and applies under the same conditions as that feature.
Bloodrager Add +1 to your total number of bloodrage rounds per day.
Druid Add +1 hit point to your animal companion. If you ever replace your animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.
Fighter Choose the dirty trick or trip combat maneuver. Add +1/3 to your CMB when attempting this maneuver (maximum bonus of +4).
Oracle Reduce the penalty for not being proficient for one weapon by 1. When the nonproficiency penalty for a weapon becomes 0 because of this ability, you are treated as having the appropriate Martial or Exotic Weapon Proficiency feat for that weapon.
Ranger Add +1/4 to a single existing favored enemy bonus (maximum bonus +1 per favored enemy).
Rogue Add a +1 bonus on your sneak attack damage rolls during the surprise round or before the target has acted in combat.
Shaman Gain +1/6 of a new shaman hex.
Shifter Add a +1 bonus on Survival checks to follow tracks through jungles.
Skald Add +1 to your total number of raging song rounds per day.
Spirit Warrior Add +1/2 to Perception and Stealth checks when you have an active aura.
Summoner Add +1 hit point to your eidolon.
Witch Add +1/4 to your caster level when determining the effects of the spells granted to you by your patron.
